units.source_text: 基督像上的紫花地丁，倒是令人感到很像马利亚的心。

en.t: The violets on the statue of Christ somehow seemed very much like Mary's heart.

units.source_text: 千重子又把视线从灯笼移到紫花地丁上—忽然，

en.t: Chieko moved her gaze again from the lantern to the violets, and suddenly,

units.source_text: 她想起了饲养在古丹波 [1] 壶里的金钟儿。

en.t: she remembered the bell crickets she had kept in an old Tanba jar [1].
